comparison: Pareto comparisons only after hard gates; no weighted composite score

preparation_cpu_per_simulated_second.definition: Sum full observed CPU cost of every runtime preparation launched in common [t0,t1), including failed/rejected/late calls, divided by t1-t0. Startup and one-time construction separate. Charge terminal pending calls in full when observed on host; mark physical completion censored and report completed-within-window subset separately. Missing CPU observations yield incomplete metric, never zero.
preparation_cpu_per_simulated_second.cohort: launch cohort; never silently omit an expensive rejected or physically unfinished call

preparation_wall_p95.definition: Nearest-rank p95 of complete prepare-call wall durations in the same launch cohort; include all outcomes; startup separate.

secondary_metrics: preparation wall and CPU mean, median, p99, maximum and sample counts
preparation CPU / host wall elapsed (duty), whole-worker CPU / host wall elapsed; neither is CPU / simulated second
process peak RSS bytes and sampling cadence; initialization and runtime separately
IPOPT iterations, status, primal infeasibility and independent acceptance failures
nominal planner busy opportunities, codriver busy ticks, commitment misses and rejected handoffs separately
accepted authority intervals, reserve minimum/time below thresholds, exhaustion/fallback, censored tails
six-state wrapped-heading tracking RMS/max, planned vs actual steering/heading TV, input rate/reversals, acceleration variation
recorded center clearance/limiting side, tire utilization each axle, beta, steering/rate utilization and Frenet denominator
complete-lap time, sector time, progress rate and actual trigger/release-to-authority latency

hard_gates.rule: No accepted nonfinite solution or invalid physical state/control; all existing solver, model, actuator, load and longitudinal grip checks remain binding.
No hard-constraint, chronology, causal-information, expired/rejected authority or overlapping-solve violation.
No recorded boundary crossing; maximum predicted corridor slack <= 1e-6 m; numerical-domain failure stops branch. Center clearance is not swept-body certification.
No unexplained solver/model/preparation failure or unapproved fallback; preserve and stop on a newly observed failure.
No trajectory exhaustion in a successful run. Preserve all unsuccessful and censored cases.
Exact default/reference parity, complete source/fixture provenance, valid export, SINGLE observations and measurement isolation before dependent measurements.

complete_lap_relative_change.requires: same complete-lap definition and matched conditions; not evaluable for incomplete lap

absolute_floors.status: Engineering Review must approve SI floors before dependent acceptance comparisons
absolute_floors.method: Choose from independently assessed native sampling/reconstruction error bound and smallest scientifically material error, not the candidate result. Record evidence/units first. If reference RMS >= approved floor use C <= 1.2*A; otherwise report absolute RMS/difference and apply C-A <= 0.2*floor. No relative claim below floor. Null floor means unresolved, not zero.

applied_steering_total_variation.near_zero_reference: ratio undefined below predeclared numerical-resolution floor; report absolute variation, require independent absolute tolerance approval

peak_beta_and_tracking_error_thresholds.status: independently justify and approve before candidate acceptance; no invented vehicle-safety thresholds

provisional_operational_targets.sampling: all available native trajectory-mode observations AND integration endpoints after gated startup, plus acceptance events; report warning/critical time. Do not reclassify a low-reserve interval as abnormal to hide it.
provisional_operational_targets.architecture_A_fixed_miss_rate_reason: not applicable: variable availability, no C70 commitment deadline
provisional_operational_targets.classification: research targets, not installed safeguards or safety guarantees; failing a target prevents promotion and requires review, not evidence removal

statistical_plan.matched: same immutable fixture, gamma, starting state, timing policy, physical duration, native resource policy and control mathematics except declared candidate factor; fresh concurrent-workload-free A control for host comparisons
statistical_plan.order: paired balanced AB/BA blocks predeclared before outcomes; no early stopping for favorable performance
statistical_plan.quantile: nearest rank ceil(p*n), sorted observations; retain raw full distribution and all outliers, including failed calls; no trimming
statistical_plan.tail_caveat: These are proposed minimum interpretability counts (about ten observations in upper 1%); not sufficient proof of a bound. Extend only with review. Short pilots report descriptive tails and counts without claiming 0.5% reliability.
statistical_plan.uncertainty: per-run estimates and paired differences; 95% intervals from whole-run/paired-block resampling, preserving within-run correlation; list per-run miss clusters and longest streak. Do not treat launches as independent trials. Insufficient repetitions => descriptive only.
statistical_plan.fixed_miss_denominator: all released fixed commitments whose deadlines fall within observed physical coverage; unfinished-at-stop deadlines remain censored. Ready-but-rejected packets are separate authority failures, not successful handoffs.
statistical_plan.censoring: all attempts and early stops retained; null missing values with reasons; no extrapolated lap/sector, imputed timing or successful replacement run; surviving common-window summaries never erase failure rates
statistical_plan.coverage: publish full per-run coverage plus matched common physical-time and observed-progress windows; progress-aligned comparison is separate from time-aligned comparison. Initial seam is partial; lap is between two crossings; own-reference tracking is not racing superiority.
statistical_plan.improvement: report A-C and (A-C)/A per metric with units and uncertainty; ratios unavailable at zero or below approved floor; a tradeoff remains a tradeoff
